profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at AWS
profile.summary: I am born and raised in Northeast, Ohio. I graduated from THE Ohio State University (Go Buckeyes!) with a B.S. in Computer Science and Engineering. I currently live in Seattle, Washington where I work as a Software Development Engineer at AWS!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer in the AWS Organizations Policies space. Building secure and scalable solutions for customers to manage policies within their AWS Organization with ease.

positions.title: Engineering
positions.description: Member of the payment's team which provides a service which is the layer between the Fast internal team's and third party payment processors such as Stripe.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Software Development Engineer working on the AWS Commerce Platform team, specifically AWS Billing. 

Some of the projects that I have worked on during my time at AWS: 

- Developed an event triggered notification listener system that listens for unordered AWS SNS notifications related to changes in AWS payment family structure from an upstream data source. This system was built with Java, AWS Lambda, AWS DynamoDB, AWS SQS, AWS SNS and AWS CloudWatch.

- Built a service that allows internal customers to retrieve the above AWS payment family data via low latency, internal request/response based APIs. This service is built on AWS EC2/AWS DynamoDB and is utilized by 50+ internal teams and services up to 200 million API requests a day.

- Coordinated a one-time data source change that replaced the backend of a service from a soon to be deprecated relational data store to a non-relational data store while maintaining 100% up time and no data loss.

- Created a service that provides up to a years worth of forecasted AWS cost and usage data via both internal and external request/response based APIs. This service is built on AWS EC2 and AWS Sagemaker and services up to eight million API requests a day.

- Lead and participated in multiple system design discussions with a range of stakeholders such as engineers, managers, PMs, directors within AWS. 

- Prioritized automated testing during software builds and deployments. Utilized best practices such as multiple deployment environments so that potential issues could be ideally detected by engineers in pre-production stages.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: Member of the Featured Merchant Algorithm team which is part of the Machine Learning Platform on Amazon.com. Primarily used an proprietary logic based language to query/manipulate big data stores. I would then take this retrieved information and visualize in a web application built with Python/Django.

positions.description: I was a member of the team that provides services such as traffic, map, weather, etc. data to all Garmin devices and monitors the health of these services.
